Name: Hall of Doors (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
Adds three different size PIF hallways where you can fit doors if you're running out of door space. Kind of like the room of doors in the department of mysteries for all you HP fans, although it won't revolve and make you get lost.

You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it. Need more doors? Check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28537]Door mod[/url]!
[b]
Compatibility[/b]
Should be compatible with everything.

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher and PIF. 1.6. is required.
